items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I made 36 numbers with King Oliver

ctx.x: Yep, you see everybody created, you see what I mean? And then also everybody stole. For instance, Louis Armstrong was playing the trumpet before he was associated with King Oliver. But when he associated, got 'sociated with King Oliver directly, then he advanced in, and advanced in, from listening to King Oliver. But he was, at the end he played more than King Oliver because I - well I worked with King Oliver, 'cause at that period he wasn't playing as much as he did when he was young, see. But I still - Louis…
PS: You have some very interesting points there. One thing I'd like to grab at immediately is you just mentioned that you made 36 sides with King Oliver. Could you -
